Author: pl1nk1
Name: Plain Fly Text
Punchline: Removes skill-name labels from floating combat text, with optional custom fonts, size, alignment, and duration.
Description: Removes the skill/ability name label from floating combat text, leaving only the number. Optionally replaces native flytext entirely with a custom-rendered version: pick your own font (any .ttf you provide), text size, alignment, and how long numbers linger before fading, for every character on screen.
